onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 1 - Basement Trade: 22 - Plumbing 7145 - SUMP PUMP COMPLETE - 1 EA Install a 1/3 HP submersible sump pump, complete with pit, liner, lid, and discharge piping with a check valve, on a separate 15-amp GFCI circuit with battery backup. Remove the existing LVT flooring in the basement laundry room. Cut through the concrete floor, excavate, install a pit liner, and patch the concrete around the liner. Install a standard 1/3 HP submersible pump. Install a discharge pump to carry water away from the foundation and tie into the exterior drainage system.

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: 2 - Exterior Trade: 4 - Site work 520 - FOUNDATION DRAINAGE SYSTEM - 60.00 LF Address water infiltration into the basement from rainwater running next to the foundation on Side C and Side B. Excavate a 16" wide trench at the foundation wall, 4' beyond the house corner. Allow the shallow drainage system to be gravity-fed from the rear of the property to the sidewalk on Side A. Remove and replace the window wells on Side C to allow direct line drainage. Side B will be accessible once the sidewalk is removed. Allow the foundation wall to dry. Apply 2 coats of asphalt-based waterproofing to all exposed foundation surfaces. Lay a 4" perforated drain pipe with a sock, over 6-mil plastic, to drain to the end of the trench near the sidewalk on Side A. Incorporate gutter downspouts to feed into the drain tube. Install a drain emitter at the termination point near the sidewalk. Fill the trench with 2" or larger stone to 3" above the drain tubing. Backfill with dirt and lay sod over all disturbed soil.
onscreen_lines.note: For questions regarding the project scope, specifications, or site access, please contact: Chris Day, Housing Construction Specialist Phone: (309) 524-2053

onscreen_lines.desc: Location: Exterior Trade: 6 Concrete & Paving 950 - CONCRETE SIDEWALK 1.00 AL Address sidewalk that slopes toward the foundation, causing water to infiltrate the basement. Remove and replace sidewalk on the South Side of the house (Side B). Form and pour 4" thick, 3000 psi, 5% air-entrained concrete sidewalk on a compacted sand or gravel base. Neoprene expansion joints at 10' and control joints at 3' are required. Broom finish. Finished area shall be above grade and drain water away from the foundation. Protect from vandalism. Remove forms. Seal joints along the foundation to prevent water infiltration. Provide and install black dirt sloped from the walk. Install sod to the edge of the sidewalk to meet the undisturbed lawn. Water sod to saturation.
